appliesTo: Certified commercial applicators and operators; restricted-use pesticide applications. Illinois rules impose no private-applicator record duty.
notes: Rule text lists chemical name, USEPA registration number, amount of chemical concentration per unit treated, date, and use site. Illinois Extension says wind speed/direction is not required in Illinois but recommended for drift defense. WPS records can still apply to agricultural employers. JCAR 8 Ill. Adm. Code 250.150 returned 404 on 2026-08-14; Cornell LII remains the citation watch until a primary host is found. 2026-09-24 primary-text audit: Who-clause: “b) Certified commercial applicators and operators shall keep a record of all restricted pesticide usage for two (2) years.” (8 Ill. Adm. Code 250.150). No private record rule found; no clock.
